notes: Reviewed pins for container/flock-ocr. Change only in a reviewed PR.

engine.* was produced by running `python3 -B -m campaign_tool.records version --json` in a clean detached checkout of engine.commit (2026-11-01). It is the source inventory the installed wheel must reproduce.
wheel_sha256 is recorded by the operator from build_wheel.py output (two independent builds must agree byte-for-byte) and passed to preflight.py; it is not invented here.
expected_versions are matched against the first output line of each command (pdftotext -v prints on stderr).

engine.package_file_count is len(package_files) of that manifest: the committed files under campaign_tool/ at engine.commit minus the generated manifest members (229 at de3563f). It is not the wheel member count; tests/test_flock_ocr_container.py derives it from the pinned commit's tree.
